points.name: apps.weather.detail.draw_register
points.interpretation: The root view registers callback 0x0c60a08d with filter 21 and user data 0.

points.name: apps.weather.detail.draw_event_code
points.interpretation: The registered root callback reads the event code and enters its draw branch only for code 21.

points.name: apps.weather.detail.refresh_register
points.interpretation: The detail page registers callback 0x0c60a3f5 with filter 11 and user data 0 on its view.

points.name: apps.weather.detail.refresh_text
points.interpretation: The down-refresh handler sets updating.weather when the scroll threshold and required objects permit the refresh path.

evidence: The weather manifest registers the detail descriptor. Create stores the supplied root and registers draw and scroll callbacks. The draw handler reads and checks event code 21. The down-refresh handler examines scrolling, guards an existing timer and sets the updating label before entering its refresh UI path. Destroy clears the root and cancels associated timers.
scope: Only the listed detail-page call sites and callbacks. Other weather data refresh paths are not intercepted.
limitations: Suppressing callbacks can leave refresh UI or state inconsistent. Root slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
